I ran all fourteen queries against the input files. They returned plausible answers, but I didn't check any answer by hand against the raw data.

- **T3 and T10:** these print their keys as keywords such as `:db`. That is how qlang prints map keys, since every map key is a keyword.
- **T1:** it counts a user only when `email` is a string, so null and missing emails are excluded.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count
T4: /data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/labels | * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login) | filter ~(type | eq ::string) | groupBy * count
T8: unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first) | filter ~(type | eq ::string) | * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) | * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"
